name: Matt Fiddler
biography: is a certified and registered locksmith and Information Security Professional with over 16 years of experience. Currently he the Director of International Information Protection for a large financial services organization. Mr. Fiddler's research into lock bypass techniques have resulted in many public and private disclosures of critical lock design flaws. Mr. Fiddler began his career as an Intelligence Analyst with the United States Marine Corps. Since joining the commercial sector in 1992, he has spent the last 16 years enhancing his extensive expertise in the area of Unix and Network Engineering, Security Consulting, Computer Forensics and Intrusion Analysis.
